status: Source regression verified; PR 244 remote validation pending
area: Push transient lifecycle and cleanup classification
finding: Cleanup classified every push-attempt path as disposable without reading operation status. An isolated regression proved cleanup apply deletes an in-progress push record. Successful push, preview and no-op also left records; the stable actor/target filename let a retry overwrite an earlier recovery record.
expectedBehavior: Only complete successful records may be disposable. Active, failed, blocked, malformed and unknown records remain recoverable. Each push owns a unique transient path and cleans that path on success without overwriting another attempt's recovery bytes.
evidenceOrRepro: tests/cli/push-residue-lifecycle.test.ts failed on running before the classifier repair and passed after it. tests/cli/git-first-push-admission.test.ts failed on successful preview residue before producer repair. Selected coverage includes successful preview, publication, no-op retry, failed admission and subsequent success preserving earlier recovery bytes. Tests use temporary Git repositories with finally cleanup.
followUp: Remote CI, frozen runner and npm deployment remain separate. Preserve failed timeout recovery; do not automatically erase old failure records. Existing residue.spec.ts fails at an abandoned historical evidence expectation; its policy compatibility is unresolved and was not weakened. Broader build, lane, task close and cancellation lifecycle coverage remains incomplete. No new CLI gate, resource registry or log platform.
